title: Side effects and live-trade safety
summary: High side-effect steps need a visible plan. Live trade is never auto-executed.
narrative:
qteasy-ai labels side effects on every ToolPlan step: network, filesystem write, local state change, heavy compute.

Download/refill, backtest, optimize, and code rewrite require Plan (or an explicit run confirmation). Ask never triggers them.

Live trade steps are always plan_only. Agent/run must never auto-execute live orders. Unbounded all-market refill without dates is refused.

If no skill matches, the planner returns clarify_required or not_supported_yet — it must not silently fall back to summary_kline.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
plan = assistant.plan('download daily data from 20180101 to 20231231', response_style='raw')
print(plan['plan']['steps'][0]['side_effects'])
print(plan['plan']['execution_mode'])  # dry_run until you confirm via run()
risk_notes: Never treat Ask as a way to skip confirmation. preview shows the plan but does not execute skills.
